common.aiNotice: We use an AI model to read your documents and to get past unexpected page changes. It never types anything you have not confirmed, and you approve before anything is submitted.
common.notLegalAdvice: This is general help, not legal advice.
common.somethingWrong: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

footer.madeWith: Made with care for people who deserve simpler forms.

landing.eyebrow: For students applying to public schemes
landing.intro: Upload your documents once. We check which scheme you qualify for, fill the application for you, and stop for you whenever a real decision is needed.
landing.stepsTitle: Three steps. You stay in charge.
landing.step1Body: Add your marksheet and income certificate. We read them and you check every value.
landing.step2Body: We compare your details with the scheme's published rules and tell you plainly what passes and what is missing.
landing.step3Body: We type your confirmed details into the portal, show you every step live, and wait for your approval before submitting.
landing.trust1Body: Nothing is submitted until you have read every value and pressed Approve.
landing.trust2Title: We never skip OTP or CAPTCHA
landing.trust2Body: Those are for you. We hand them over to you every time and never try to get around them.
landing.trust3Body: Your files are removed automatically after {hours} hours. You can delete everything yourself in one click.
landing.limits1: We cannot promise that a scheme will approve you, select you, or pay you.
landing.limits2: We only work with portals we have checked. Right now that is one fictional practice portal.
landing.limits3: We never handle Aadhaar numbers or Aadhaar OTPs.
landing.limits4: We do not edit, create or improve your documents. We forward them exactly as you uploaded them.
landing.demoNote: This build uses a fictional practice portal, so you can try the whole journey safely.

auth.signInIntro: Sign in to continue your applications.
auth.signUpIntro: It takes a minute. You need to be 18 or older.
auth.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. A short sentence you will remember works well.
auth.forgotIntro: Tell us your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.resetDone: Your password is updated. You are signed in.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Open it on this device to finish signing up.
auth.demoLoginNote: For judges and testers. It signs you in to a shared practice account.
auth.sideTitle: We fill the forms. You make the decisions.
auth.sideBody: An independent helper for students applying to public schemes. Your details stay encrypted and are yours to delete.

errors.invalid: That email and password do not match. Please check them and try again.
errors.notConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. We sent you a link when you signed up.
errors.weakPassword: Please use at least 12 characters for your password.
errors.exists: An account with this email may already exist. Try signing in instead.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.linkExpired: That link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
errors.generic: We could not do that just now. Please try again.

onboarding.title: A few things before we start
onboarding.aboutIntro: We use your name and date of birth to fill applications. We also check that you are 18 or older.
onboarding.languageIntro: Choose the language for this website. You can change it anytime from the top of the page.
onboarding.consentIntro: Each permission is separate. Leave a box unticked if you do not agree. You can change your mind anytime in Settings, and withdrawing is as easy as agreeing.
onboarding.consentStoreBody: We store your confirmed details, encrypted, so we can fill forms for you. This one is needed to use the service. You can delete everything anytime.
onboarding.consentAi: Read my documents with an AI model
onboarding.consentAiBody: An AI service reads your uploaded documents to suggest values, and helps when a portal page changes. The service may process this outside India. If you leave this off, you type your details yourself and everything else still works.
onboarding.consentAgent: Let the assistant act on the portal for me
onboarding.consentAgentBody: When you press Start on an application, our assistant fills that one application for you. It never submits without your final approval. You will also be asked to confirm each time.
onboarding.under18Body: You need to be 18 or older to use this assistant, so we have not saved your details and we have removed your sign-up. Please ask a parent or guardian to help you apply directly on the official portal.

errors.name: Please enter your full name.
errors.dob: Please enter a real date of birth, for example 05/03/2004.
errors.storeRequired: We need permission to keep your profile so we can fill forms for you. Without it, we cannot help yet.

dashboard.intro: Here are your applications. We keep you posted at every step.
dashboard.startBody: Pick a scheme. We will check whether you qualify before anything else.
dashboard.emptyInProgress: Nothing in progress. When you start an application, it shows up here.
dashboard.emptyReceipts: No receipts yet. After a submission, your tracking ID and receipt live here.

wizard.chooseTitle: Which scheme are you applying for?
wizard.chooseIntro: We only list schemes whose rules and portal we have checked.
wizard.eligibilityIntro: We check the scheme's published rules against your confirmed details. No AI is used for this.
wizard.ruleUnknown: We will check this after you confirm your details
wizard.overallEligible: You meet every rule we can check.
wizard.overallIncomplete: So far so good. We need your documents and details to finish checking.
wizard.overallNotEligible: Your details do not meet at least one rule, so applying would not succeed. Please check your details if something looks wrong.
wizard.uploadIntro: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB each. Use your own documents. We forward them to the portal exactly as they are.
wizard.uploadAadhaarWarning: Please do not upload an Aadhaar card or any document showing an Aadhaar number. We do not accept them.
wizard.typeMyself: I will type my details myself
wizard.aiOff: Reading documents with AI is off in your permissions, so you will type your details yourself.
wizard.practiceModeHint: Expired sessions, slow dropdowns, a pop-up and strict date formats, so you can see how we handle them.
wizard.warmingUpBody: Our helper sleeps when nobody is using it. This can take up to a minute.
wizard.readingBody: This usually takes under a minute. You can stay on this page.

uploadErrors.tooBig: This file is larger than 2 MB. Please upload a smaller copy.
uploadErrors.type: We accept PDF, JPG or PNG files only.
uploadErrors.aadhaar: This file seems to show an Aadhaar number. We never process Aadhaar, so we did not save it. Please upload a document without it.
uploadErrors.rate: Too many uploads just now. Please wait a minute.
uploadErrors.consent: Please allow us to keep your profile (Settings) before uploading.
uploadErrors.generic: We could not upload that file. Please try again.

confirm.title: Does this look right?
confirm.intro: Check each value against your documents. Edit anything that is wrong. We only ever use values you confirm here.
confirm.confidenceLow: We were not sure. Please check carefully

review.title: Here is what we will do
review.intro: We will open a fresh, private browser, fill these sections, and stop whenever the portal needs you.
review.willPause: We will pause for you at: {list}
review.authorise: I authorise the assistant to fill this one application for me, using only the details I confirmed.

run.title: Your application
run.noScreenshot: A picture of the portal appears here once we start.
run.screenshotAlt: Screenshot of the portal at step {step}. Sensitive fields are covered.
run.auditIntro: Every action we took, with sensitive values masked.
run.cancelConfirm: Cancel this application? Nothing will be submitted.
run.connection: Live updates paused. We are checking every few seconds instead.
run.expiredTitle: We paused to keep you safe
run.usage: AI use for this application: {calls} calls

checkpoint.captchaTitle: The portal is asking a CAPTCHA question
checkpoint.captchaWhy: CAPTCHAs check that a real person is present. We never answer them ourselves.
checkpoint.otpTitle: The portal sent you a one-time password
checkpoint.otpWhy: OTPs prove it is really you. We never read or guess them. Type the code you received.
checkpoint.otpDemoInboxNote: On the practice portal, your "SMS" appears here instead of on your phone. Only you can see it.
checkpoint.otpNoMessage: No message yet. It can take a few seconds.
checkpoint.finalWhy: This is exactly what will be submitted. Read every line. After you approve, we tick the declaration and press Final Submit once.
checkpoint.mismatch: These values look different on the portal's own preview: {list}. Please check the screenshot.
checkpoint.declaration: By approving, you confirm the portal's declaration that the information is true and the documents are your own.
checkpoint.expiresIn: We will wait up to 10 minutes.

receipt.title: Your receipt
receipt.statusExplain: The portal has received your application. It will now be checked by the office running the scheme. On the practice portal, nothing is sent to any real office.
receipt.screenshots: What we saw, step by step
receipt.noGuarantee: A submitted application does not guarantee approval, selection or payment.

settings.title: Settings and privacy
settings.consentsIntro: Turn each permission on or off. Every change is recorded with the date and notice version.
settings.storeOffWarning: Turning this off deletes your saved profile. Your documents and applications stay until you delete them or they expire.
settings.exportBody: Get a copy of everything we hold about you as a JSON file: profile, permissions, documents list and application logs.
settings.deleteTitle: Delete my account and all data
settings.deleteBody: This permanently removes your account, profile, documents, screenshots, receipts and logs. It cannot be undone.
settings.deleted: Your account and all your data have been deleted.
settings.retentionNote: Uploaded documents and portal screenshots are deleted automatically after {hours} hours.

legal.templateBanner: Template: to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

grievance.title: Grievances and help
grievance.intro: If something went wrong, or you want to use your rights over your data, please write to our Grievance Officer.
grievance.ack: We acknowledge every grievance within 24 hours.
grievance.resolution: We aim to resolve it within 15 days and will tell you if we need longer and why.
grievance.include: Please include your account email, what happened, and when. Never send passwords, OTPs or Aadhaar numbers.
grievance.rights: You can ask to see, correct, or erase your data, withdraw any permission, or nominate someone to act for you. You can also complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

errors.notFoundTitle: We could not find that page
errors.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped. Let us take you somewhere useful.
errors.errorBody: It is not you, it is us. Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell us on the Grievances page.
